changes: Add: a page only for us to log a pattern we juggled, with suggestions while typing the siteswap, half-star ratings and a warning when a siteswap is not on the list
Add: a logged pattern goes straight into our practice list, and the site has it within seconds
Add: a random celebration GIF after saving a pattern, never the same one twice in a row; it stays until you tap it away

Add: milestones after saving, each with its own GIF and message: the last patterns, every new percent with the expected completion date, complete families, first sync, first 8-club pattern, dragons, new favourite, daily records, late-night sessions and many more
Generator: on our own devices, a button to log the drawn pattern on the Add page with the siteswap filled in
Progress, stats and all patterns are updated as soon as we log a pattern, instead of every hour
Stats: a calculator under Juggling time that shows how many years and weeks the whole list takes, with sliders for practice days per week and hours per session
Home: the intro no longer says how many patterns Brook has left
Requests: the No button is only red once you choose it
Web app: Funky Orbit under the logo when the app starts
Pattern pop-up: Rating before our stars, lined up with Difficulty
Videos: 3 side by side on a wide screen and 1 at a time on a phone, with the arrows above the video
Videos: the arrows move one video at a time through all our videos
Videos: the date no longer touches the edge of the card with a 7-digit siteswap

Sharper video thumbnails, in the full resolution of the video on sharp screens

Generator and pattern pop-up: how many clubs each of us starts with in each hand, in their colours; Mees on the left and Piet on the right as in our videos, with who starts

Funny stats: on a wide screen Patterns, Recording days and Dates side by side

The pop-up of a thrown pattern now also shows its difficulty
Home: the newest videos page by page (3 on a phone, 6 on a wider screen) with arrows, or swipe on a phone
Home: a link to all our videos on YouTube
Home: filter the videos by date: this week, this month, a practice day or your own dates; the filter is kept in the link
Generator: choose All, 3, 5, 7 or Sync, so you can also draw only sync patterns
New intro on the home page, with a short explanation of the orbits and our club colours
Funny stats: the figures in clear groups, First and Last recording together, Busiest date with its number of patterns, and no more double counts
Funny stats: Dragons (95) under Patterns with…
Dates everywhere written the same way, like Sat 26 Sep 2026
